text: Tianjin University currently offers 67 undergraduate programs, most of them are 4-year full-time study (except for the program of architecture which requires 5 years). The programs are usually delivered in Chinese, while Chemical Engineering (IChemE Accredited), Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering and Pharmaceutical Science could be taught in English. Students will be awarded with a Bachelor's degree and graduation certificate if they finish all of the given course work and pass their thesis defense. Furthermore, students pursuing majors that are taught solely in Chinese are required to achieve a band score of 5 under the Chinese Language Proficiency Scales for Speakers of Other Languages. Students pursuing the major of Chinese are required to achieve a band score of 6 or equivalent. Students pursuing majors that are taught solely in English are required to achieve a band score of 4.
